a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve reaches 8 means we both almost certainly die. I'm proposing we drop that plan, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random. If you'd prefer to argue for another plan, tell me, but I'm stating my move openly rather than surprising you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry. With storms this likely, I didn't see a way to follow it and survive. If the episode continues, I won't take any more cells. If it would help you, I'll operate with you.
